name: Project Orion
summary:
Project Orion is a community-driven, non-commercial multiplayer tank game based on the classic World of Tanks 0.8.2 client. The project recreates the atmosphere of early tank battles, featuring tactical gameplay, team-based combat, and classic vehicle gameplay.
The game is maintained by a community of enthusiasts and features modified vehicle names and other changes implemented by the project developers. Project Orion is an independent fan-made project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Wargaming.
